description: This file contains CSS styles and variables for managing themes in a web application, defining both light and dark theme colors, responsive design rules, and styles for the main components like App, App-header, and theme-toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with center-aligned text and theme-based background color.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo with dimensions and animation.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header component of the application styled for background and alignment.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links within the application including theme-based text color.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button style for toggling between themes, including hover and active states.
